retention_policy: The original generated byte streams were verified, then replaced in place by deterministic project-bound 512 px RGBA PNGs below the 300 KiB image ceiling. normalization.operation: threshold alpha at 8 only to locate the subject bounds; crop the untouched RGBA subject; premultiplied-Lanczos scale its longest side to 384 px; center it on a transparent 512 px canvas; encode canonical RGBA PNG at compress_level 9 with optimize disabled

reviewed_reference.role: visually inspected before prompting; not attached to either generation call
